title: Fixed-width array field loads and stores
summary: Executes a compiler-emitted field address, load, or store for arbitrary element width and field index, preserving caller locals and the operand-stack tail.
premises: Exact equality with the emitted field-access region
Combined getters for the pointer and encoded element index
For a load or store, the wrapped address plus eight lies inside current memory
For a load, the memory word equals the specified value
For a store, the value local contains the specified word
An operand-stack tail and a continuation consuming the exact result
result: Address calculation preserves the store and pushes the wrapped word address. A load pushes the specified word and preserves the store. A store writes exactly that word, preserves all other store fields and caller locals, and restores the operand-stack tail.
